column1: # Columns (tab separated): provider  service  proto  host  port
#   proto is tls or ssh. {region} is replaced by --region (per-provider defaults below).
#   Default regions: aws=us-east-1  azure=eastus  gcp=us-central1  ibm=us-south  oracle=us-ashburn-1
# Add your own rows freely; lines starting with # are ignored.
# proto may also be: quic, dtls, ike, dnssec, dnscurve, dnscrypt, starttls-smtp|imap|pop3|ldap|ftp|xmpp|postgres|mysql
# For dnssec and dnscurve the host column is a zone name. For dnscrypt the service column is the provider name.
# Also holds the public NTS time servers (Netnod, PTB) as a reference for the ntp probe.
# Signed top-level zones (Verisign .com, PIR .org, US .gov) and ietf.org show what deployed DNSSEC looks like
# today, for comparison with the vendor zones above; dnscurve.org is the reference zone that proves the
# DNSCurve probe works. Delete these rows if you do not want them in the totals.
